description: THE AMPLIFY LANE — the live campaigns anchored on official @rokha_agent posts that roster promoters may carry. kind `amplify` earns Brought points for what a tracked link BRINGS (a sign-in 20 once that user runs within 7 days · first run 10 · paid run 2 · an agent connected 10 · a listing created 15 · a bounty entered 5); kind `pin_week` (Pin of the Week) earns tier weight × 5 points per verified pinned day (5 of 7 random daily checks; the official post or your own #ad-labelled quote of it). Points rank you on the ONE Incubation board; the top 10 places — the Members — are paid USDC every Friday on a fixed table. Never paid for a post's likes or views. Public, no auth.
